This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by their short stature and slimy pink heads.<ref name="TLJ" /> These heads could potentially be detached from their bodies.<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref>

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Slimy-Alien-Daiyu.png|left|200px|thumb|A young Leia Organa runs past a member of this species in a tank at the Daiyu marketplace]]
One member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Kenobi II" /> in [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> They appeared to be contained in one of the tanks displaying creatures within the [[Daiyu marketplace]], though only their head was visible, almost appearing to lack a body.<ref name="Kenobi II" /> Later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> another member of this species was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Michael Kaplan's team pulled the proportions back to the original drawing by the cut and the design of the costume. It's subtly brilliant. His ability to have that sympathy with creatures makes him quite unique. It's one thing to dress the human body, but it's another to dress one of an alien that doesn't conform to human proportions. And to still be able to make it feel like, 'He's a sharp dressed guy, isn't he? He's got his spats on, his walking stick, and his tails. He absolutely looks like he's just come from Saville Row, kitted out for a night in Monte Carlo.|[[Neal Scanlan]]|<ref name="Art of TLJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Unidentified-Slimy-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 21 by Ivan Manzella]]
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], though it the design was later altered by [[Michael Kaplan]] and team.<ref name="Art of TLJ" /> This species was one of two species created for ''The Last Jedi'' that were referred to by the production code "King 21."<ref name="Art of TLJ" />

Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], initially expressed that he did not know why this happened, clearing up the confusion by referring to the [[Unidentified forehead species|other species]] as "K021 species" in the official [[Holocron continuity database]], while this one,<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref> which he described simply as the "slimy alien,"<ref name="Slimy Alien">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-02|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357032845113163869|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Slimy-Alien.png}}</ref> he said was still identified as "King 21" behind-the-scenes.<ref name="Unnamed Aliens" /> However, he later realized this species was also referred to by their correct production code, "King 36," which had erroneously been assigned to a [[Unidentified ridged-head species|different species]] that should have been titled "King 66A."<ref name="Production Codes">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357405484679958799|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Masseur-Species.png}}</ref> As of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within Chee's Holocron.<ref name="Unnamed Aliens" />
